messages:
julia: Hi team — auditor asked for a concise mapping between our RBAC change process, the artefacts we produce for evidence, and where to find logs proving who approved/merged changes. They also want proof of KMS access around key usage and any vuln/incident linkage. Can someone outline what we can hand over?

sam: For RBAC changes we have PRs + approval logs in GitHub + merge webhook events. Bundle: repo: redwood-infra, PRs tagged with label `compliance:rbac`. Example PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/policies/pull/482 

kevin: For approvals the timeline is: PR -> two approvers required -> CI gated -> merge. Evidence = PR diff + `approvals` section + GitHub audit log export for that timeframe. Quick splunk query to show merge events:```
index=github_webhooks event=push OR event=pull_request action=merged repo=redwood-infra
| table _time, actor, repo, pr_number, merge_commit
```

ash: KMS access: we can export CloudTrail key usage events for the CMKs. Path we hand auditors: s3://redwood-compliance-exports/kms-usage/YYYY-MM-DD/*.json (we keep 1y snapshots). We include CMK ARNs and request IDs. Sample filter: `eventName=Encrypt OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey`

compliance-bot: Reminder: evidence bundle export job completed: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/2951234567-rbac-kms-bundle.tar.gz (contains PRs, github-audit.json, cloudtrail-kms.json, splunk-merge-snapshot.json) :package: 

julia: Great — how do we show linkage between a vuln triage and an RBAC change? Auditor wants an incident crosswalk.

sam: We keep an incidents index where triage notes reference PRs or commit SHAs. Example triage comment: "mitigated by infra PR #482". Splunk query across incidents index and github events:```
index=incidents earliest=-30d
| search notes="*PR #*" OR notes="*commit *"
| stats values(notes) as references by incident_id
```

kevin: Also attach the changelog and deployment tags in the evidence bundle. If a vuln required a key rotation, include KMS rotation runbook + rotation audit log (CloudTrail RotateKey events) and the deploy pipeline run id.

ash: One more auditor ask: retention justification for logs > 90 days. We have retention policy doc in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/log-retention — include snapshot and signoff (security lead).

julia: OK action items: 1) sam export PRs + GH audit logs for date range (sam to confirm by EOD). 2) kevin export CloudTrail KMS usage + rotate key events (include ARNs). 3) ash collect incident crosswalks and attach triage notes. 4) upload bundle and post link here.

sam: On it — will upload to s3 path above and ping once done.

compliance-bot: Upload succeeded: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/2951234567-rbac-kms-bundle.tar.gz (checksum: sha256:3a7b9f...)

julia: Thanks — I'll send this to the auditor with a short mapping doc. If they want additional raw logs we can grant scoped S3 access for 48h. :thumbsup:
